crossRefs.note: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.
They took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
Yahweh’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land…
crossRefs.keyword: Allon-bachuth. i.e., the oak of weeping

crossRefs.note: They called the name of that place Bochim, and they sacrificed there to Yahweh.

people.name: Allon-bacuth
people.line: The burial place of Deborah, Rebekah's nurse.

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Rebekah
people.line: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau

translations.web: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.
translations.bsb: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried under the oak below Bethel. So Jacob named it Allon-bachuth.
translations.kjv: But Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allonbachuth.
translations.asv: And Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried below Beth-el under the oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bacuth.
